priorityList: Summon your pet or use Grimoire of Sacrifice before combat starts.
Summon Infernal on cooldown, ideally synchronized with Malevolence and offensive trinkets.
Use Malevolence on cooldown, preferably while Infernal is active.
Cast Ruination immediately whenever it becomes available.
Cast Soul Fire if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Chaos Bolt if Demonic Art is active or if your Diabolic Ritual buff is about to expire to cycle your next demon.
Maintain Wither (or Immolate) on your target; refresh it when it has less than 30% of its duration remaining.
Cast Cataclysm on cooldown if you are talented into Lake of Fire.
Cast Shadowburn if the target is below 20% health or if you have the Fiendish Cruelty buff.
Spend Soul Shards on Chaos Bolt if you have 4 or more shards, or while Malevolence or Infernal is active.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have 3 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Conflagrate if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards and no Backdraft stacks.
Cast Incinerate if the Chaotic Inferno buff is active and you are not at shard cap.
Use Incinerate as your primary filler to generate Soul Shards.
